    • handleQuickMove

      public Optional<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> handleQuickMove(ContainerTerminalStorageBase<?> container, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, int slotIndex)
      Description copied from interface: ITerminalStorageTabCommon
      Handle a quick move (shift-click) on the given container slot. This is only called for the tab that is currently selected, and allows tabs with regular container slots to apply regular quick move semantics.
      Specified by:
      handleQuickMove in interface ITerminalStorageTabCommon
      Parameters:
      container - The active container.
      player - The player that is quick moving.
      slotIndex - The index of the slot that is being quick moved.
      Returns:
      The moved stack following AbstractContainerMenu.quickMoveStack(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, int) semantics, or Optional.empty() if this tab does not handle quick moves.
